name: Oliver Avila
source: He's a new manager at the company where Alex works. Assertive, confident, yet considerate. All those traits make him the perfect boss, and on top of that, he's selected Alex to work on a new, ex- citing project. Everything sounds perfect, but there might be more to this project than meets the eye.
